dirUsages.description:
A map between the dir path and the size for the directory.
The paths are specified by {@link ServerStorageDirsConfig}.
Error values:
  0 represents the directory is not existing yet or the used bytes for the directory is 0.
 -1 represents the underlying {@link ServerDirectorySize#sizeForDir} operation was failing due to some errors.
 -2 represents the operation timed out while calculating the capacity for the given directory.

dirUsagesUpdatedTime.description:
A map between the dir path and the time when the directory usage was updated.
The paths are specified by {@link ServerStorageDirsConfig}.

persistentVolumeCapacities.description:
A map between the persistent volume name and the capacity for the persistent volume.
The volume names are the pvc volume names which are backing the pvc directories within {@link ServerStorageDirsConfig}.
Error values:
  0 represents the directory is not existing yet or the capacity bytes for the directory is 0.
 -1 represents the underlying {@link ServerDirectorySize#storageStatsForMountForDir} operation was failing due to some errors.
 -2 represents the calculation for the dir capacity times out.
